gen-gf-offside-gf-genos: Wide-spaced and unclosed, Offside makes a statement without raising its voice, while Genos tucks its glyphs in tight under a high midline. One shows off the shapes; the other keeps the eye moving.
gen-gf-offside-gf-geom: Commanding letters with open, unfinished curves lead here, each stroke held to one thickness like drawn cable, while Geom follows in a plain sans with a lofty lowercase. Offside speaks; Geom keeps the conversation going.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hammersmith-one: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside leaves its curves open and its weight level from start to finish. And Hammersmith One, a sans with rounded cord-like strokes and capitals barely above the lowercase, simply gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-inder: Commanding, wide-set Offside draws even its g in a single unchanging line weight. Inder follows as a plain sans where capitals and lowercase sit close in height, so the text stays tidy and quick to take in.
gen-gf-offside-gf-jaldi: Expressive from the first letter, Offside has a blunt round-tip marker feel that never lets up. Jaldi follows in a sans that looks brushed on, tightly set, with a tall x-height and a gaping c that feels friendly beside it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Loud, wiry curves, spaced wide apart. Offside shines at bending round letters like wire into a bold statement, while Kdam Thmor Pro, a modern sans-serif, fills its lines with full bowls for steady text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-krona-one: Wide, wiry, and fully confident. Offside holds its strokes at constant width from stem to curve, while Krona One, a loose-set sans with a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals, brings a heavier, friendlier presence beside it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-magra: Commanding and level, Offside runs without any hairline-to-stem shift. Its best quality is how Magra, a sans with a big-bodied lowercase, adds a visible thick-and-thin rhythm underneath.
gen-gf-offside-gf-major-mono-display: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside holds a level beat with curves that never quite close. Major Mono Display brings tube-like neon-glass strokes and big sidebearings, so a monospace paragraph would read slowly, like a row of glowing signs.
gen-gf-offside-gf-martian-mono: Offside brings widely tracked, expressive curves that stay open and a level weight from end to end. But Martian Mono, a monospace with fixed-width code-style letters and generous openings, gives that boldness a structured, orderly footing.
